_comment: Numen STT (voice-input) providers. backend='whisper-http' means OpenAI-compatible POST {base}/v1/audio/transcriptions (multipart file+model), batch: nothing is sent until you release the mic. backend='doubao' (Volcengine) and backend='dashscope' (Alibaba Model Studio) are realtime WebSocket ASR: audio streams while you speak and partial text lands in the input box as you talk. Per provider: base URL + known model ids; 'modelLabel' renames that field in the settings screen when 'model' would be a lie (Doubao's model name is always 'bigmodel', so the field carries the resource id instead). Model lists checked against each vendor's own docs (2026-08); best-effort, may drift. 'name' and 'modelLabel' are shown as written, except that a value that is a language key (numen.stt.provider.<id>) is translated to the current language. USER-EDITABLE: this is copied to config/numen/stt.json on first run; edit that file to add your own providers/models or override URLs. Built-in providers are the base and your file overrides them by id, so providers added in later versions still show up. The settings 'custom' model escape hatch also accepts any id.
